brief:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu announced at a conference with the Druze community that he conducted a "very short and sharp" phone call with Ahmad al-Shara, asserting the conversation stopped what he termed a "massacre," according to Israel Hayom. Netanyahu pledged to take all necessary measures to protect the Druze population.

Netanyahu indicated there are undisclosed files and actions he cannot reveal publicly related to the matter.
